29template <typename T>
30inline void compute_rhs_alpha(const BSSNGridSoA<T> &G, Field3D<T> &rhs_alpha,
31 size_t padding = 4) {
32 using namespace tensorium_RG::fd;
33 const T ko_sigma = T(0.1);
34
35 size_t I0, I1, J0, J1, K0, K1;
36 G.domain_bounds(I0, I1, J0, J1, K0, K1);
37
38 const size_t total = G.alpha.st.nx_tot * G.alpha.st.ny_tot * G.alpha.st.nz_tot;
39 std::fill(rhs_alpha.ptr(), rhs_alpha.ptr() + total, T(0));
40
41 const size_t i0 = clamped_lower(I0, padding, I1);
42 const size_t j0 = clamped_lower(J0, padding, J1);
43 const size_t k0 = clamped_lower(K0, padding, K1);
44 const size_t i1 = clamped_upper(I1, padding, I0);
45 const size_t j1 = clamped_upper(J1, padding, J0);
46 const size_t k1 = clamped_upper(K1, padding, K0);
47
48 if (i0 >= i1 || j0 >= j1 || k0 >= k1)
49 return;
50
51#pragma omp parallel for collapse(2)
52 for (size_t i = i0; i < i1; ++i)
53 for (size_t j = j0; j < j1; ++j)
54 for (size_t k = k0; k < k1; ++k) {
55 const size_t id = G.alpha.idx(i, j, k);
56 const T alpha = G.alpha.ptr()[id];
57 const T K = G.K.ptr()[id];
58 const T beta_x = G.beta[0].ptr()[id];
59 const T beta_y = G.beta[1].ptr()[id];
60 const T beta_z = G.beta[2].ptr()[id];
61 const T advection = beta_x * T(Dx_upwind(G.alpha, i, j, k, G.dx, beta_x)) +
62 beta_y * T(Dy_upwind(G.alpha, i, j, k, G.dy, beta_y)) +
63 beta_z * T(Dz_upwind(G.alpha, i, j, k, G.dz, beta_z));
64 rhs_alpha.ptr()[id] = advection - T(2) * alpha * K +
65 T(KO6(G.alpha, i, j, k, ko_sigma));
66 }
67}

72template <typename T>
73inline void compute_rhs_beta(const BSSNGridSoA<T> &G, Field3D<T> rhs[3],
74 const GaugeParameters<T> &params = {}, size_t padding = 4) {
75 using namespace tensorium_RG::fd;
76 const T ko_sigma = T(0.1);
77
78 size_t I0, I1, J0, J1, K0, K1;
79 G.domain_bounds(I0, I1, J0, J1, K0, K1);
80
81 const size_t total = G.beta[0].st.nx_tot * G.beta[0].st.ny_tot * G.beta[0].st.nz_tot;
82 for (int c = 0; c < 3; ++c)
83 std::fill(rhs[c].ptr(), rhs[c].ptr() + total, T(0));
84
85 const size_t i0 = clamped_lower(I0, padding, I1);
86 const size_t j0 = clamped_lower(J0, padding, J1);
87 const size_t k0 = clamped_lower(K0, padding, K1);
88 const size_t i1 = clamped_upper(I1, padding, I0);
89 const size_t j1 = clamped_upper(J1, padding, J0);
90 const size_t k1 = clamped_upper(K1, padding, K0);
91
92 if (i0 >= i1 || j0 >= j1 || k0 >= k1)
93 return;
94
95#pragma omp parallel for collapse(2)
96 for (size_t i = i0; i < i1; ++i)
97 for (size_t j = j0; j < j1; ++j)
98 for (size_t k = k0; k < k1; ++k) {
99 const size_t id = G.beta[0].idx(i, j, k);
100 const T beta_vec[3] = {G.beta[0].ptr()[id], G.beta[1].ptr()[id],
101 G.beta[2].ptr()[id]};
102 for (int comp = 0; comp < 3; ++comp) {
103 const Field3D<T> &field = G.beta[comp];
104 const T adv = beta_vec[0] * T(Dx_upwind(field, i, j, k, G.dx, beta_vec[0])) +
105 beta_vec[1] * T(Dy_upwind(field, i, j, k, G.dy, beta_vec[1])) +
106 beta_vec[2] * T(Dz_upwind(field, i, j, k, G.dz, beta_vec[2]));
107 rhs[comp].ptr()[id] = adv + params.beta_B_coeff * G.B[comp].ptr()[id] +
108 T(KO6(field, i, j, k, ko_sigma));
109 }
110 }
111}

116template <typename T>
117inline void compute_rhs_B(const BSSNGridSoA<T> &G, const Field3D<T> rhs_Gamma[3],
118 Field3D<T> rhs_B[3], const GaugeParameters<T> &params = {},
119 size_t padding = 4) {
120 using namespace tensorium_RG::fd;
121 const T ko_sigma = T(0.1);
122
123 size_t I0, I1, J0, J1, K0, K1;
124 G.domain_bounds(I0, I1, J0, J1, K0, K1);
125
126 const size_t total = G.B[0].st.nx_tot * G.B[0].st.ny_tot * G.B[0].st.nz_tot;
127 for (int c = 0; c < 3; ++c)
128 std::fill(rhs_B[c].ptr(), rhs_B[c].ptr() + total, T(0));
129
130 const size_t i0 = clamped_lower(I0, padding, I1);
131 const size_t j0 = clamped_lower(J0, padding, J1);
132 const size_t k0 = clamped_lower(K0, padding, K1);
133 const size_t i1 = clamped_upper(I1, padding, I0);
134 const size_t j1 = clamped_upper(J1, padding, J0);
135 const size_t k1 = clamped_upper(K1, padding, K0);
136
137 if (i0 >= i1 || j0 >= j1 || k0 >= k1)
138 return;
139
140#pragma omp parallel for collapse(2)
141 for (size_t i = i0; i < i1; ++i)
142 for (size_t j = j0; j < j1; ++j)
143 for (size_t k = k0; k < k1; ++k) {
144 const size_t id = G.B[0].idx(i, j, k);
145 const T beta_vec[3] = {G.beta[0].ptr()[id], G.beta[1].ptr()[id],
146 G.beta[2].ptr()[id]};
147 for (int comp = 0; comp < 3; ++comp) {
148 const Field3D<T> &B_field = G.B[comp];
149 const Field3D<T> &gamma_field = G.tildeGamma[comp];
150 const T adv_B = beta_vec[0] * T(Dx_upwind(B_field, i, j, k, G.dx, beta_vec[0])) +
151 beta_vec[1] * T(Dy_upwind(B_field, i, j, k, G.dy, beta_vec[1])) +
152 beta_vec[2] * T(Dz_upwind(B_field, i, j, k, G.dz, beta_vec[2]));
153 const T adv_gamma = beta_vec[0] *
154 T(Dx_upwind(gamma_field, i, j, k, G.dx, beta_vec[0])) +
155 beta_vec[1] *
156 T(Dy_upwind(gamma_field, i, j, k, G.dy, beta_vec[1])) +
157 beta_vec[2] *
158 T(Dz_upwind(gamma_field, i, j, k, G.dz, beta_vec[2]));
159 rhs_B[comp].ptr()[id] = adv_B + (rhs_Gamma[comp].ptr()[id] - adv_gamma) -
160 params.eta * G.B[comp].ptr()[id] +
161 T(KO6(B_field, i, j, k, ko_sigma));
162 }
163 }
164}
